epic.title: [EPIC] User Administration improvements — organization config defaults, LLM allow-list, user editing & super-admin
epic.goal: Tighten the User Administration backoffice so internal admins can configure organizations, manage users, and grant super-admin rights without leaving the UI. Removes obsolete fields, fixes defaults that no longer reflect product reality, and adds missing user lifecycle operations.
scope: 1) Set the Brand Image questions to 20 by default — default value for newly created organizations; existing organizations keep their current value.
2) Remove the Frequency field from organization creation/edit form and read view.
3) Remove the 'Competitors / category (auto-detected)' field from organization creation/edit form.
4) Rename 'Brand x Markets max' to 'Markets' on create, edit, and read views with tooltip update.
5) Replace 'LLMs Max' with an LLM allow-list (checkboxes per LLM: ChatGPT, Gemini, Grok, Claude, Perplexity).
6) Allow modification of existing users (name, organization membership, super-admin flag).
7) Allow setting / unsetting Super-admin at user creation and modification via role dropdown.
8) Enforce READER role restrictions in GEO — 'New analysis' button disabled, all creation entry points disabled, read-only access to existing reports.
outOfScope: No change to authentication / SSO setup.
No change to org-level branding / theming.
No additional customer-facing roles beyond READER and the existing default (full CRUD) in V1.

acceptanceCriteria.given: a super admin creates a new organization
acceptanceCriteria.then: the Brand Image questions field defaults to 20, the Frequency and 'Competitors / category (auto-detected)' fields are absent, the 'Brand x Markets max' label reads 'Markets', and the LLMs configuration is a checkbox allow-list (not a numeric max)

acceptanceCriteria.given: a super admin edits an existing organization
acceptanceCriteria.then: the new defaults and field set apply consistently; legacy LLMs-Max values are migrated to a pre-checked allow-list reflecting the previous count under the canonical LLM order

acceptanceCriteria.given: a super admin opens the users page
acceptanceCriteria.when: they click Edit on a user row
acceptanceCriteria.then: they can update the user's editable fields including Super admin being available in the role dropdown and the change persists

acceptanceCriteria.given: a super admin creates a new user
acceptanceCriteria.when: they select the Super admin role in the dropdown
acceptanceCriteria.then: the user is granted super-admin rights without a separate ticket

acceptanceCriteria.given: super-admin grants/revokes are performed via the UI
acceptanceCriteria.then: an audit log captures the actor, target, action (grant/revoke), and timestamp

acceptanceCriteria.given: a user with the READER role logs into GEO
acceptanceCriteria.then: the 'New analysis' button is rendered in a disabled/greyed-out state, is not clickable, and shows a tooltip explaining the restriction
all sections (Overview, categories, AI Citation Sources, etc.) load with the full data their organization has access to — no data is hidden by the role

acceptanceCriteria.when: they attempt any report-creation entry point (duplicate, on-demand run, scheduled trigger)
acceptanceCriteria.then: the action is blocked client-side via disabled controls and server-side rejects the request if bypassed
